subject: Invoice submission: portal acceptance criteria, sample payloads, and email-backstop flow
messages:
From: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@acmecorp.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Systems <accounts-payable@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2025-05-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Invoice submission: portal acceptance criteria, sample payloads, and email-backstop flow

Hi Marcus / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the call yesterday. As we prepare to activate our vendor profile with Redwood, AP needs a short checklist so our billing system can push invoices cleanly. Two things we need from you: a minimal CSV (or sample rows) that your portal will accept, and confirmation of whether an email fallback (SMTP) is acceptable for the first 90 days.

Quick questions to help us map fields:
- What exact PO element do you require to match (PO number in invoice line, header, subject token)?
- If we submit multiple PO lines in a single PDF/CSV, can your system split into separate ledger lines or does each file have to be one PO only?
- What filename convention and subject token should we use for email fallback?
- Ack turnaround: will we get immediate parse acks (200/accepted) or a daily manifest?

Attached is a small CSV export from our ERP (acme_invoice_sample.csv) and a sample PO for context (PO-12345.pdf). If you prefer, Sasha (cc'd) from VendorTech can coordinate transmitting a sanitized test batch.

Goal: have an acceptance checklist and one sample payload by next Tuesday (2025-05-13) so we can schedule the onboarding run.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connell
Finance Operations
Acme Corp

Attachment(s): acme_invoice_sample.csv (text/csv), PO-12345.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-05-09T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice submission: portal acceptance criteria, sample payloads, and email-backstop flow

Hi Liam — appreciate the clear ask and the sample files. Internal note: Kim, FYI on field mapping questions below.

High level: we prefer portal-first for onboarding (idempotency, acking, and better metadata), but we support an SMTP/email backstop for up to 90 days during initial activation with strict subject/filename rules. Summary answers inline:

- PO matching: our system supports matching on PO number found in the invoice header OR a subject token. Header PO is preferred; subject token is supported for email fallback.
- Multi-PO in one file: portal can accept multi-line CSVs that reference multiple PO numbers as separate line items — our ingestion will split to ledger lines, but email PDFs should ideally be single-PO to avoid manual intervention.
- Filename convention / subject token: for email fallback please use subject: "INVOICE-REDBRIDGE <vendor-id> <po-number>" and filename format: vendorid_YYYYMMDD_poXXXXX.csv or .pdf. We'll provide a vendor-id after activation.
- Ack cadence: portal returns immediate parse acknowledgements (within seconds) with a unique ingest id. Email fallback returns a batched manifest once per hour and an overnight reconciliation file.

Action items we can take on our side: provide a lightweight CSV schema (header row + field types), supply a vendor-id, and run a single-supplier test ingest in the sandbox. Vanessa, can you own the sandbox test window and provide the vendor-id once we approve the sample schema?

Liam — we'll review the attached CSV and send a compact sample schema by EOD today. If VendorTech can produce a sanitized set with 5 representative rows (multi-line, multi-PO, tax lines), that will speed validation.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Program Manager, Vendor Activation
Redwood Inference

Attachment(s): (none)

From: Sasha Ivanov <sasha@vendortech.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-05-10T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice submission: portal acceptance criteria, sample payloads, and email-backstop flow

Thanks — Sasha from VendorTech here. We can definitely produce sanitized test exports. A couple of clarifying points from our side before we generate the 5-row sample: 

1) Line-level taxes: do you expect separate tax lines or embedded tax amount on each invoice line? We can provide both variants.
2) Currency and multi-entity: if a single CSV contains rows for two different payment entities, do you want two files or will the portal route based on a payment_entity column?
3) PDF fallback: we can generate a combined PDF with multiple invoices; per Marcus's note we will prioritize single-PO PDFs if email fallback is used.

Below is a sanitized 3-row sample preview (we'll attach the csv in the next mail):

"invoice_date,invoice_number,po_number,payment_entity,description,qty,unit_price,currency,tax_amount
2025-04-28,ACM-1001,PO-12345,Acme-US,Consulting retainer,1,15000,USD,0
2025-04-28,ACM-1002,PO-12346,Acme-US,Expense reimbursement,3,150,USD,22.5
2025-04-28,ACM-1003,PO-99999,Acme-EU,Professional services,1,8000,EUR,0"

If that layout looks good, we'll attach the CSV and a PDF variant and point the sample email to the subject token you specify.

Regards,
Sasha Ivanov
Solutions Lead
VendorTech (on behalf of Acme Corp)

Attachment(s): (will send acme_sanitized_sample.csv in follow-up)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-05-12T16:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice submission: portal acceptance criteria, sample payloads, and email-backstop flow

Quick internal decision summary for PROC-452 — sending to the vendor once Kim signs off on one small CSV tweak: 

Decision: portal-first onboarding + 90-day email backstop with restrictions.

Acceptance checklist (to share with Acme):
- Provide CSV with header row using our canonical schema (we will hand the schema in the outbound mail).
- PO match on header PO number preferred; subject token supported for emails.
- Email subject: "INVOICE-REDBRIDGE <vendor-id> <po-number>" (vendor-id assigned after sandbox schedule).
- Filenames: vendorid_YYYYMMDD_poXXXXX.csv or .pdf; no spaces, underscore delimiter.
- Multi-PO: portal can accept multi-PO rows; email PDFs should be single-PO where possible.
- Tax lines: accept either embedded tax or separate tax line; require currency and payment_entity columns for routing.
- Acking: portal = immediate ingest ack + ingest id; email = hourly manifest + overnight reconciliation.
- Security: emails must be sent from vendor-authorized domains; docs with PII should be uploaded to portal only.

Next steps: Kim to confirm the canonical schema tweak (one column rename) by EOD tomorrow; Marcus to generate vendor-id and sandbox window; I will draft the outbound email to Acme and VendorTech once schema is final.

—Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Vendor Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment(s): none
